short.q: State two reasons why a Muslim recites Al-Fatiha in every prayer.
short.answer: It is a pillar of the prayer, and it praises Allah and asks Him for guidance.
short.working: 1 mark for each reason.

short.q: Describe what the Prophet (S.A.W.) did every night before sleeping with Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Naas.
short.answer: He joined his hands, blew into them, recited the three surahs and wiped his body with his hands.
short.working: 1 mark for blowing into the hands, 1 mark for the three surahs, 1 mark for wiping the body.

short.q: Write the seven surahs studied in this lesson and give the number of verses in any three of them.
short.answer: Al-Fatiha (7), Al-Kafirun (6), An-Nasr (3), Al-Masad (5), Al-Ikhlas (4), Al-Falaq (5), An-Naas (6). Any three with correct number of verses.
short.working: 4 marks for naming all seven (award proportionally), 1 mark for three correct verse counts.

short.q: Explain why the Prophet (S.A.W.) is called Al-Amin and how a child can be trustworthy.
short.answer: The people of Makkah trusted him with their valuables because he was honest. A child can keep promises, return borrowed items, and keep secrets.
short.working: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the reason, 2 marks for two ways.

short.q: Explain why we say Bismillah before eating.
short.answer: We ask for Allah's blessing and remember that food is from Him. It makes eating an act of worship.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid reason.

short.q: Design a short role-play showing the etiquette of eating, listing at least five actions.
short.answer: Wash hands; sit; say Bismillah; eat with right hand; eat from in front; do not criticise; say Alhamdulillah at the end.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct action, up to 5.

short.q: List the steps of brushing teeth correctly.
short.answer: Say Bismillah, use a pea-sized amount of paste, brush outer, inner and chewing surfaces, brush the tongue, rinse and store the brush.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct group of steps up to 3.

short.q: State three values learned from participating in sports.
short.answer: Teamwork, sharing, humility, fair play, discipline, leadership.
short.working: 1 mark for each value.

short.q: What is an attribute of Allah? Give one example.
short.answer: A quality that describes Allah, for example Ar-Rahman, the Most Kind.
short.working: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for a correct example.

short.q: Explain how the greeting "As-salamu alaykum" is connected to a name of Allah.
short.answer: As-Salam is Allah's name meaning the Source of Peace. The greeting is a prayer for peace and safety.
short.working: 1 mark for As-Salam, 1 mark for meaning of the greeting, 1 mark for the link.

short.q: State the duties of Malakul Maut and of Raqib and Atid.
short.answer: Malakul Maut takes souls at death. Raqib and Atid record our deeds.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Explain, using one of the angels, how angels' duties help us in our lives.
short.answer: Jibril brought the Qur'an that guides us; Mikail's duty of rain helps crops; Raqib and Atid keep record so we can be rewarded; Malakul Maut reminds us to prepare; Israfil reminds us of the Day of Judgement.
short.working: 1 mark for the name, 1 mark for the duty, 1 mark for the benefit, 2 marks for a clear explanation.

short.q: Explain how Prophet Yusuf (A.S.) showed honesty and truthfulness.
short.answer: He refused to do wrong when tempted, he feared Allah, and stayed honest even in prison. The Qur'an calls him Siddiq.
short.working: 1 mark for refusing wrong, 1 mark for honesty in hardship, 1 mark for Siddiq.

short.q: Choose any two prophets and explain one virtue from the life of each.
short.answer: For example: Ayyub showed patience in illness; Ibrahim showed generosity to guests.
short.working: 1 mark for each prophet, 1 mark for each virtue, 1 mark for a clear explanation.

short.q: Describe how to clean a medium najasa on a mat.
short.answer: Remove the substance, pour water until the colour, smell and taste have gone, then dry.
short.working: 1 mark for removal, 1 mark for washing until traces go, 1 mark for drying.

short.q: Define wudhu and state its intention.
short.answer: Wudhu is washing certain parts of the body with water to prepare for prayer. The intention is made in the heart.
short.working: 1 mark for definition and 1 mark for intention.

short.q: Explain why wudhu is important in the life of a Muslim.
short.answer: It is required for prayer; it cleans and refreshes; it brings reward; it prepares the heart for meeting Allah.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid point.

short.q: Describe how to find the Qibla using the sun in Kenya.
short.answer: Stretch the right arm towards the sunrise, which is east, and face forward, which is roughly north. Confirm with a compass or mosque.
short.working: 1 mark for the right arm to east, 1 mark for facing north, 1 mark for checking.

short.q: What is a pillar of swalah?
short.answer: A part of the prayer which must be done for it to be valid.
short.working: 1 mark for part and 1 mark for validity.

short.q: Explain tuma'ninah and give the story that shows its importance.
short.answer: Tuma'ninah is staying still and calm in each position. The Prophet told a man who prayed hurriedly to go back and pray again.
short.working: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for the story, 1 mark for the lesson.

short.q: State three rules for using working animals safely.
short.answer: Do not overload, give water and rest, do not beat, keep them healthy.
short.working: 1 mark for each rule.

short.q: State two reasons why we wear clothes.
short.answer: To cover the body, to protect us from weather, and to look neat and dignified.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: How can a child respond politely to a friend who laughs at their modest dress?
short.answer: Stay calm, explain that they dress that way because of their faith, and do not insult back.
short.working: 1 mark for calm, 1 mark for explaining, 1 mark for not insulting.

short.q: Explain what a Muslim child should do before sharing a message.
short.answer: Check whether it is true and kind, and useful and safe. If not sure, do not share, as Qur'an 49:6 says to verify news.
short.working: 1 mark for true, 1 mark for kind, 1 mark for useful or safe, 1 mark for the verse or verifying.

short.q: State three evils of begging.
short.answer: Loss of dignity, laziness, wasted resources, lies, harm to children.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: State two ways a child can earn or save money safely.
short.answer: Chores for a small reward with permission, and saving in a box or school scheme.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Describe what you should do when you enter your home.
short.answer: Say Bismillah and the dua, greet with salaam, place shoes neatly, wash hands, speak kindly.
short.working: 1 mark for each of four actions.

short.q: Explain how the Prophet (S.A.W.) showed love to children.
short.answer: He kissed and hugged them, including his grandson Al-Hasan, and said that those who show no mercy will not be shown mercy.
short.working: 1 mark for each of the points.

short.q: State the dua for parents and its meaning.
short.answer: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira: My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.
short.working: 1 mark for words and 1 mark for meaning.

short.q: Describe how to show patience to an elderly parent or grandparent.
short.answer: Listen without complaining, help them to walk and eat, speak gently.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Explain the hadith about keeping family ties and provision.
short.answer: Whoever wants his provision increased and life extended should keep good relations with relatives. Family ties bring blessing.
short.working: 1 mark for the hadith idea, 1 mark for the two rewards, 1 mark for blessing.

short.q: Draw or describe a simple family chart showing at least five relatives and their Kiswahili names.
short.answer: For example: babu, bibi, baba, shangazi, mjomba, binamu, each placed correctly.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct relative up to 5.

short.q: State four teachings from the first five verses of Surah Al-Alaq.
short.answer: Seek knowledge; read in Allah's name; Allah is the Creator and Most Generous; writing is important; we learn what we did not know.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: State three ways Khadija (R.A.) helped the Prophet (S.A.W.).
short.answer: She was first to believe, comforted him, supported him with wealth, stayed with him in hardship.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Choose one early convert and explain a lesson children can learn from that person.
short.answer: For example, Ali teaches that a young person can be brave and truthful for Allah.
short.working: 1 mark for the person, 1 mark for a fact, 1 mark for a lesson, 1 mark for clear explanation.

short.q: Explain the difference between patience and revenge with a school example.
short.answer: Patience is staying calm and trusting Allah, while revenge is hurting back. If a classmate teases you, you stay calm and tell a teacher instead of fighting.
short.working: 1 mark for patience, 1 mark for revenge, 1 mark for example.
